title: moments in an unfinished painting
content_html:
moments in an unfinished painting

Jun 29 2025

a painting is a living thing
it flows from life and reveals life
whilst being outside of life
it is born but it never breathes
as if it is constantly in the process of birth

yet it bares many scars, already
scratched, dissolved, scrubbed
yet every violent act is done with love
and hope
that the layers will reveal an impermanence


many years pass… it is still not yet ready
it is still of the unnameable
and when it becomes time
it will rest, still
beyond the reach of clocks
